// Random Headgear Box -- picks one headgear from the pool of this era. F_RndHeadgearBox(slot): 0 = any, 1 = upper,
// 2 = middle, 3 = lower. The pool is every headgear in the stock pre-renewal item database that no monster drops and no NPC
// sells or gives out (417 items; a headgear with several slots is in each of its slots' lists). The ones the client has no
// item name for are named in System/itemInfo.lua. Add or remove ids freely. The full list is in POOL-pre-renewal.md.
